user_report_th: ตัวขาดๆ ก้มแล้วเข่าหาย ต้องการตัวทั้งชิ้น หัวกับผม อาวุธ เอฟเฟกต์ตามอาวุธ
root_cause_observed: Front pickup torso/costume compression plus separately transformed upright knee/shin sprites produces missing-looking leg volume. Surface/contact and connected-component gates did not establish coherent full-body acting.

new_runtime_policy.body_outfit: one complete authored posed raster per exposure; includes all arms legs knees hands cape and scarf
new_runtime_policy.head_hair: one complete logical head layer, pose-appropriate art and neck registration
new_runtime_policy.weapon: separate logical layer with frame sockets and front/back occlusion
new_runtime_policy.weapon_trail: separate logical layer with explicit timing and front/back occlusion

not_a_fix: independently resizing or aligning each frame
